reason: The cited evidence shows Sn can suppress pest oxidation in Nb-silicide alloys (E1, E2), but it does not demonstrate that Sn forms a protective scale or diffusion barrier in the equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr system, nor does it provide any data on mechanical property retention with Sn additions. The mechanism and property preservation claims are unsupported extrapolations.
premises: Sn addition suppresses pest oxidation in Nb-silicide alloys
Sn promotes a protective, adherent oxide scale
Sn acts as an oxygen diffusion barrier along grain boundaries
Sn addition does not degrade mechanical properties of refractory alloys
Sn effects in Nb-silicide alloys transfer to equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr
